correctness.rationale: Native matching-complex faces are every pairwise disjoint subset of the 24 edges of M16. Fresh independent finite enumeration gives exactly 11,394 faces and f-vector (1,24,228,1096,2834,3880,2588,696,47). Separate direct mod-2 simplicial boundary elimination gives reduced Betti 2 in degree 4 and 4 in degree 5; all M4..M14 have homology confined to one degree. The provided complete integral acyclic matching and Smith-unit arguments, consistent with the earlier published integral Morse proof, identify the actual wedge homotopy rather than merely these Betti numbers.
residual_risks: The newly presented 98 KB integral Morse certificate was not independently fully replayed; independent computation confirmed the face census and mod-two Betti ranks, while integral homotopy also rests on checked written chain/cancellation argument and the earlier full integral proof.

value.rationale: The Möbius-ladder ordinary matching complex is natural and the mixed-dimensional homotopy is worthwhile, but this precise integral type and its discrete-Morse certificate were published already, including the key 16-vertex transition from pure degrees at 12 and 14. Checking a few smaller base cases is a routine finite extension and does not justify a distinct new accepted result.

limitations: No infinite family formula; first occurrence only across even sizes 4..16.
